cost.binNote: 40 is only the 0-stack cost (matches RiftWalk.RBaseCost and the sheet's flat cost:40). The wiki's own formula scales cost with accumulated stacks (40 x 2^stacks, stacks 0-4); see value r_7.

values.meaning: Cast Cost Scaling With Riftwalk Stacks
values.binNote: The wiki states cost = 40 x 2^stacks for stacks 0-4 (40/80/160/320/640 mana), which is exponential and cannot be written as this schema's flat base + linear terms. RBaseCost=40 is the 0-stack base; RManaRatio=2 and RStackManaRatio=1 look like the formula's base and per-stack exponent rate (2^(1*stacks)), matching the wiki's numbers exactly, but no calc row in the sheet derives this - it is my reading of two otherwise-unexplained data values, not a stated calculation.

mechanics.claim: After the blink deals damage, Kassadin gains a Riftwalk stack for 15 seconds; casting again refreshes the duration on all held stacks, up to a cap of 4.
mechanics.quote: He then gains a stack of ''Riftwalk'' for 15 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 4 times.

mechanics.claim: Riftwalk's damage is dealt to all nearby enemies upon arrival at the blink destination, not at the instant of casting.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival

mechanics.claim: Each held Riftwalk stack both adds the per-stack bonus damage and raises the cast's mana cost; the wiki does not say whether a cast's own new stack (gained after arrival) counts toward that same cast's damage/cost or only affects the next cast.
mechanics.quote: For each stack, ''Riftwalk'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} at an increased {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}}.
